items.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bombing is found dead in Ukraine, authorities say
items.description: The woman suspected of trying to kill a Ukrainian business tycoon in a bombing attack in Monaco last week was found dead in Ukraine with gunshot wounds to the head, Ukraine’s Security Service said on Tuesday. FRANCE 24's Morgan Ayre reports.

items.title: How Malian jihadists and pro-independence groups joined forces to overthrow the junta
items.description: For years, jihadists from JNIM and pro-independence fighters from the FLA harbored deadly hatred for each other. But they put their differences aside to confront their common enemy: the ruling junta in Bamako. Since April 25, they have launched a major offensive.

items.title: Ukraine: Suspect in Monaco bomb attack found dead near Kyiv
items.description: Ukrainain prosecutors say the body of the woman suspected of the bombing that targeted businessman Vadym Yermolaiev was found near Kyiv. Police said they had detained two individuals suspected of murdering her.
